newsitem.title: TRINIDAD AND TOBAGO: Trinidad teens jailed for 42 years.
newsitem.headline: Trinidad teens jailed for 42 years.

text.p: A court in Trinidad has sentenced two teenagers to 42 years in jail each and 20 strokes with the birch for trying to murder a man during a robbery.
Augustus Fareel and Corneal Francis, both 19, were found guilty of trying to kill Joseph Brown during a break-in at his home in Chaguanas in September 1995.
Passing sentence on Friday, Justice Anthony Lucky said the sentence must reflect how society felt about the "horrible and horrendous" offences.
